messages:
erin: Heads-up: I opened a docs PR to add an "onprem troubleshooting" subsection for Private installs covering network MTU, HSM socket permissions, and offline bundle restore steps. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1257

erin: Suggested troubleshooting checklist I'm adding:
- Verify MTU mismatches (common with SR-IOV): `ip link show` and `ip link set dev eth0 mtu 1400` example
- HSM socket perms: `stat -c '%a %U:%G' /var/run/hsm/pkcs11.sock` and recommendation 660 root:hsm
- Offline bundle restore: staged verify -> extract -> chown -> systemd daemon-reload

liam: Nice. For MTU note: add a quick mention that large MTU can break gRPC streaming and KV cache transfers. Also show how to test by `dd if=/dev/zero bs=1M count=10 | nc -l 12345` on one host and `nc host 12345 | dd of=/dev/null` on the other to observe drops.

noor: On HSM examples, please avoid real file paths. Use placeholder like `/var/run/hsm/<socket>` in docs and show masking in sample CI logs: `echo "PKCS11_SOCKET=***masked***"`. Also include `read -s PIN` example when showing PIN usage in snippets.

erin: Good call. I'll replace absolute paths and add the PIN snippet. Also adding a short troubleshooting flowchart: check network -> verify socket perms -> check agent journal (`journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200 --no-pager`).

liam: Small doc nit: when suggesting `systemctl daemon-reload`, remind users to `systemctl restart redwood-agent.service` and include a minimal unit fragment patch example showing `After=network-online.target` and `Restart=on-failure`.

infra-bot: PR opened by erin/docs: "onprem troubleshooting: MTU, HSM perms, offline restore"  CI: pending (docs-lint, linkcheck) https://github.com/redwood/inference-docs/pull/1257 :robot_face:

erin: Thanks all. I'll update the PR with placeholders, masking examples, and the MTU test. Will wait for linkcheck then merge.
